purposes.ticket_open_v1: Create a ticket with the requested subject and priority; verify initial state open.
purposes.ticket_read_v1: Read the created ticket as its owner; verify matching details and state open.
purposes.ticket_closed_read_v1: Read the created ticket after closure; verify matching details and state closed.
purposes.ticket_close_v1: Close the created ticket; verify state closed and matching details.
purposes.ticket_denied_v1: Read another owner's ticket as visitor; verify access is denied with HTTP 403.
purposes.ticket_list_v1: List the current role's tickets; verify the items collection exists.
